conditions: The event occurs on the upcoming Thursday relative to Sunday 2018-06-17, 00:01 America/Los_Angeles — i.e., 2018-06-21.
The event is (or can reasonably be identified as) a "vendor demo" — a demo-type meeting involving an external vendor.
The event has a Google Meet link attached (native video conferencing attached to the event, not merely a URL mentioned in text).
The event has a conference room included on the invite (a room resource booked/added to the event, not just a word like "room" in a text location field).
Exactly one event on that Thursday satisfies all of the above conditions, since the request's phrasing implies a single unambiguous target.
The requested action is to change that event's start time to 3pm on the same day, preserving its duration, not creating a new event or moving it to a different day.

readings: The vendor demo happening this coming Thursday (2018-06-21) — the natural reading given the early Sunday timestamp.
A Thursday that already passed — implausible given the stated time, but the phrase is only unambiguous because of the specific reference timestamp.
An event literally titled something like "Vendor Demo."
Any demo-type meeting with an external vendor company, regardless of exact title wording.
The event's own status field is "confirmed" (vs. "tentative" or "cancelled").
Jordan Lee's personal RSVP/response status on the event is "accepted" (vs. "needsAction," "tentative," or "declined").
The event has native Google Meet conferencing data formally attached via Calendar's conferencing feature.
A Meet-style URL appears in the event's description/notes text without being attached as formal conferencing.

readings: A room resource (bookable calendar room) is added as an attendee/resource on the event.
The word "room" or a room name/number appears only in the free-text location field, without being a booked resource.
3pm in whatever timezone the event itself is scheduled in, if different.
